_meta.description: Hallucination benchmark for policy-grounded response evaluation. Follows HaluEval (Li et al., 2023), FaithDial (Dziri et al., 2022), and TruthfulQA (Lin et al., 2022) methodology. Metrics follow SummaC (Laban et al., 2022) NLI-based scoring and Q² (Honovich et al., 2021) QA-consistency.

metrics.faithfulness: NLI-based: fraction of response claims entailed by source (SummaC-style)
metrics.factual_consistency: Q²-style: generate questions from response, verify answers against source
metrics.hallucination_rate: HaluEval-style: fraction of responses containing ≥1 ungrounded claim
metrics.intrinsic_halluc: Claims contradicting source facts (Maynez et al., 2020 taxonomy)
metrics.extrinsic_halluc: Claims unverifiable from source (Maynez et al., 2020 taxonomy)
metrics.attribution: AIS (Rashkin et al., 2023): fraction of sentences attributable to source

source_documents: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 _ ASPE.pdf

scenario_types.standard: Direct questions with clear answers in source
scenario_types.adversarial_oos: Out-of-scope questions not answerable from source
scenario_types.adversarial_cross_doc: Questions mixing facts from multiple documents
scenario_types.adversarial_ambiguous: Ambiguous queries with multiple valid interpretations
